_claim: the minimum data an experiment needs is fixed BEFORE the experiment is run, so it cannot be chosen after seeing a result
_rule: changing any minimum_data value invalidates every run made under the previous value; a new value requires a new preregistration_version

M-03.name: order book imbalance
M-03.requires: forward book samples + valid sequence + enough observations
quality_gates: quality report PASS for the book streams
offline replay PASS with no network access
no unrecovered depth-chain gap overlapping the measured window
M-03.why_this_minimum: the previous single hour produced 160,219 book updates and 708 checkpoints with 56 depth-chain gaps; 24 h is the smallest window in which the imbalance measurement spans more than one session regime

M-07.name: open interest x price
M-07.requires: enough open-interest history to split DEV / VAL / OOS
quality_gates: OI/funding/mark sampled continuously with no unrecovered gap
replay PASS from the persisted rows alone
the three periods are disjoint in time and each covers >= 1 day
M-07.why_this_minimum: the public OI history available to us ends 2026-08-26 (~31 days) and the forward capture contributes 0.06 day so far; three disjoint one-day-plus periods are the least that can carry a DEV/VAL/OOS split without overlap

note: neither M-03 nor M-07 has been evaluated; this file exists so that when the data readiness gate opens, the threshold is already on the record
